title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Arlington, VA

Compensation: $28.00 - $34.00 / hour

Description

About The Role:
Innovative Defense Technologies (IDT), a leading defense technology company, is seeking a Software Engineer Intern to be part of our Missile Defense team and based out of our Arlington, VA location.

Leveraging advanced software automation, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), and AI-driven capabilities, IDT accelerates capability development, enhances operational readiness, and reduces lifecycle costs for the Department of Defense. The company is dedicated to transforming defense systems through innovation, efficiency, and mission-critical results.

Clearance & Location Requirements:
All applicants must be able to obtain/maintain an active Secret U.S. Security Clearance.
This is a fully on-site position based out of our Arlington, VA location.

What You Will Do:

What You Will Do:
Develop, test, and maintain software applications and features.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement new capabilities and resolve software defects.
Write reliable, maintainable code in accordance with engineering, security, and quality standards.
Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and debugging activities.
Integrate software components, APIs, and third-party technologies into existing systems.
Support software deployment, maintenance, and modernization efforts.
Create and maintain technical documentation and development artifacts.
Contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis through deployment and sustainment.

Who You Are (Required):

Who You Are (Required):
Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate degree program with a major in software engineering, computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, data science, cyber security, mathematics, or aeronautical engineering
Familiarity with Git or similar version control systems.
Familiarity with Linux-based environments and command-line tools.
Familiarity with SQL and relational database technologies (e.g., PostgreSQL).
Familiarity with container technologies such as Docker, Podman, or OCI-compliant containers.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

What Makes You Stand Out:
Experience writing scripts for automation using languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Groovy.
Experience maintaining, troubleshooting, or upgrading software applications and services.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern software development practices.
Familiarity with DevSecOps concepts and secure software development principles.
Experience working in Agile development environments.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work and communicate project status effectively.
Demonstrated initiative, willingness to learn new technologies, and ability to take ownership of assigned tasks.

If you see yourself reflected in this role and are excited about the impact you could make, we encourage you to apply! If you know someone who may be a great fit, please feel free to share this opportunity with your network.

Pay Range*: $28 - $34 / Hour
This amount may not be reflective of actual compensation that may be earned as pay is dependent on a candidate’s experience, skills, and education. The posted range does not include bonuses, commissions, tips, or other benefits. IDT is often looking to place multiple candidates at various levels. Therefore, more than one pay range has been included, commensurate with experience.

Why Work at Innovative Defense Technologies (IDT):

IDT’s Summer Internship Program offers students the opportunity to learn from experts and perform meaningful work in a professional work environment. IDT interns gain valuable, hands-on experience and solve real-world problems. In this program, students can expect:
A 10–12-week program; up to 40 hours per week
Competitive pay
Individual mentoring
Valuable training
A supportive culture
Social events and team building activities

EEO Statement:
IDT is an Equal Opportunity employer.
